name: Commercial Faces
summary: Campaign portraits of you: skincare, corporate, sportswear or editorial.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/edit's (built by tools/build_apps.py); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Campaign
inputs.default: a sportswear campaign shot: the same person in a black athletic top, a light sheen of sweat, dramatic low-key lighting with a rim light, dark concrete gym background, intense look at the camera, editorial composition.

options.value: a sportswear campaign shot: the same person in a black athletic top, a light sheen of sweat, dramatic low-key lighting with a rim light, dark concrete gym background, intense look at the camera, editorial composition.
options.label: Sportswear

options.value: a skincare advertisement: the same person in a soft white top with glowing dewy skin, holding a small white jar of face cream near the cheek, bright white studio with soft beauty-dish lighting, clean pastel backdrop, glossy magazine composition.
options.label: Skincare advert

options.value: a corporate brochure portrait: the same person in a tailored navy suit, standing in a bright glass office with a blurred city view behind, soft window light, confident friendly expression, crisp professional photography.
options.label: Corporate brochure

options.value: a fashion editorial shot: the same person in a structured designer coat, dramatic side light carving the face, a seamless colored paper backdrop, a strong pose, high-end magazine photography.
options.label: Fashion editorial

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.
